_comment: d01 = SABLONA. Skopiruj themes/d01 -> themes/dNN, zmen id/name a vsetko nizsie. Klucom zacinajucim '_' sa nic nedeje (komentare). Vsetky polia okrem 'name' su volitelne; chybajuci kluc = hodnota dizajnu 'current' (gfx kolo 2). Plna schema: docs/DESIGNS.md.
name: Šablóna – Neon
author: Alt C. (coding)
_palette_comment: UiPalette (vsetky panely, grafy, mapa v kode). Kluc = nazov konstanty malymi pismenami. Hex #RRGGBB alebo #RRGGBBAA.
_hud_comment: Horny panel (karty Peniaze/Dlh/Majetok, hodiny), strategicke ramy (strategic_skin) a pozadie hernej obrazovky (bg_*). *_modulate = nasobenie farby textur ramov (moze byt > 1 ako [r,g,b]).
_menu_comment: Hlavne menu. background = cesta relativne k tomuto priecinku (Texture2D: .png s .import alebo .tres). use_theme_buttons/use_theme_panel: menu prevezme styl tlacidiel a panelu z theme.tres. particles_tint/parallax_tint = modulate svetielok a parallax vrstiev.
_motion_comment: Motion – zoznam klucov a defaultov v docs/DESIGNS.md. dur_scale nasobi vsetky trvania, ktore nemaju vlastny kluc. Easing: <trans>_<ease>, trans = linear|sine|quad|cubic|quart|quint|expo|circ|back|elastic|bounce|spring, ease = in|out|in_out|out_in.
_map_comment: Mapa. tint = self_modulate celej 2D mapy (#ffffff = bez zmeny). water_* a shallow_line = more, country_border = okraj krajin (alfa 0 = povodny tmavsi okraj). border/border_light/hover/selected/label/label_shadow = Atlas mapa (DEV). hover_glow/select_glow/select_core/edge_shadow/edge_width = glow a pulz vyberu (map_fx_overlay).
_countries_comment: Farby krajin. mode = terrain (terenna paleta terrain_* + politicky odtien) alebo palette (farba z palette/fixed + odtien). political_mix = sila odtiena 0..1, political_s/v = sytost a jas odtiena. palette/fixed platia aj pre Atlas mapu (alpha_far/alpha_near).
